infoLinks.urlText: Eastern Suburbs bus diversions for City2Surf
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 9 August
  • From 5.55am until approx. 2.40pm, route 386 services will start and end trips in Rose Bay due to road closures for the annual City2Surf fun run.  
  • Buses travelling to Bondi Junction will start trips at Dover Rd after Carlisle St (202925) and return to normal route on Old South Head Road.  
  • Buses travelling to Vaucluse will end trips at Old South Head Rd at Dover Rd (202926).  
  • Stops on New South Head Road will be missed in both directions.  
  • The first complete trips will leave Bondi Junction at 2.25pm and Vaucluse at 2.38pm.  
  • Plan ahead and allow extra travel time. Visit the City2Surf event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Watsons Bay service changes for City2Surf
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 9 August, route 325 services will start and end trips early, or not run at all, while roads are closed for the annual City2Surf fun run.  
  • From first service until 12pm, services will not run in either direction. 
Changes for buses leaving Watsons Bay and travelling towards the city  
  • From 12pm, buses will start trips from Edgecliff Station, New South Head Rd, Stand N (202726). 
  • From 1.20pm, buses will start trips from New South Head Rd at Newcastle St (202955). 
  • At 2.46pm, the first complete trip from Watsons Bay will run to Walsh Bay. 
Changes for buses leaving Walsh Bay and travelling towards Watsons Bay 
  • From 12pm, buses will end trips at Edgecliff Station, Stand E (202716). 
  • From 1pm, buses will end trips at New South Head Rd at Caledonian Rd (202949). 
  • At 1.31pm, the first complete trip from Walsh Bay will run to Watsons Bay. 
  • At 2.25pm, the first complete trip from Edgecliff will run to Watsons Bay. 
Plan ahead, allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the City2Surf event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weekend closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 15 and Sunday 16 August, L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork.
 
During this time:
 
L1 Dulwich Hill line
  • L1 light rail services will not run.
  • Use alternative transport including L1 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able, between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill.
L1 replacement bus services will run from 5am to 1am daily, with a frequency of every 10 to 15 min from 5am to 9pm and every 15 to 20 min from 9pm to 1am. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Capitol Square (in both directions): please use the alternative stop at Paddy’s Market (approx. 5 minute walk) for buses towards Dulwich Hill/The Star, or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk)
  • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk)
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
 
Where the replacement bus has an Opal reader on board, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.

L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford lines
  • L2 and L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
  • Use alternative transport including trains, metro, regular bus services or walking if able, between Circular Quay and Central.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will continue to run between Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford as per normal schedule.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner to see if your travel is affected.
L1, L2 and L3 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Monday 17 August.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 609:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • New weekend and evening services with access to Tweed Valley Hospital. 
All services extended beyond Tweed Valley Hospital to Kingscliff shops at Pearl Street. 
 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125
  • S126
  • S127
  • S887

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 601:
  • New timetable and minor route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week, including additional weekday evening services to better suit shift times at Tweed Valley Hospital.
  • Extended from Tweed Valley Hospital to Kings Forest. 
  • Kings Forest residents have a new way to access TAFE NSW Kingscliff campus.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see route 601 service Sutherland Street.
Every second route 601 service will terminate at Tweed City Shopping Centre. Passengers wanting to continue travel to Tweed Mall can take select route 601 services or change to other bus services at Tweed City Shopping Centre (routes 600, 603, 605, 606).  

See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 606:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Services to/from Fingal Head extended between Tweed Mall and Tweed City Shopping Centre, with 46 additional services per week. 
Fingal Head and Banora Point passengers can access Tweed City Shopping Centre from Minjungbal Drive. All other route 606 services will enter the Tweed City Shopping Centre carpark for the start and end of services.

See the news article for more information.

  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 606:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Services to/from Fingal Head extended between Tweed Mall and Tweed City Shopping Centre, with 46 additional services per week. 
Fingal Head and Banora Point passengers can access Tweed City Shopping Centre from Minjungbal Drive. All other route 606 services will enter the Tweed City Shopping Centre carpark for the start and end of services.

See the news article for more information.
subtitle: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June

infoLinks.urlText: Lilyfield Light Rail lift is not available from 15 June
infoLinks.content:
• The lift at Lilyfield Light Rail stop will be out of service from 15 June until further notice while replacement works are carried out.
  • During this period, access to the light rail stop will be available only via stairs, if you are able to do so safely.
  • Customer requiring lift access should use the nearest accessible light rail stop at Leichhardt North.
  • To get to Leichardt North stop, from the Lilyfield stop, take the local 437 bus route from the Balmain Rd after Lilyfield Rd stop, exit at the Norton St after City West Link stop and walk to the Leichhardt North light rail stop to catch the light rail.
  • Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 5 July, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western Sydney. 
  • Transport for NSW is introducing new bus services to connect Penrith, Oran Park, Campbelltown, Liverpool, Mount Druitt and Leppington with local centres, the new Western Sydney International Airport*, and in the future, to the emerging Bradfield City Centre.
  • New routes 772, 790, 825, 840, 845, 849 and 860 will deliver better connections 7 days a week for Western Sydney, linking communities to employment hubs, transport and essential services with frequent, reliable, and sustainable transport.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.
*Passenger services will commence in October 2026.

infoLinks.urlText: New school bus services for students from Calderwood and surrounds
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April, three new school routes will be introduced to serve the Calderwood catchment and surrounds.

New routes:
  • S269 – Calderwood to St Josephs HS
  • S270 – Calderwood to Albion Park HS
  • S271 – Calderwood to Shellharbour Anglican College
These routes will be operated by Premier Illawarra and will service St Joseph’s Catholic High School, Albion Park High School and Shellharbour Anglican College.
 
Morning AM services
  • S269 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:38 and arrive at St
    Joseph’s at 07:48.
  • S270 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:58 and arrive
    at Albion Park HS at 08:09.
  • S271 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 08:20 and arrive at
    Shellharbour Anglican College at 08:50.
Afternoon PM services
  • S270 – Bus will depart Albion Park HS at 14:40 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 14:50.
  • S269 – Bus will depart St Joseph’s HS at 15:00 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 15:13.
  • S271 – Bus will depart Shellharbour Anglican College at 15:40 arriving at
    Escarpment Drive at 16:17.
Use the Trip Planner to plan your new trip.

infoLinks.urlText: Chisholm school bus changes from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July (Term 3), there will be a new afternoon bus route 1337 and changes to route 2763, 2522, 2611 and 1304 services, with three of the routes extending into Chisholm.
 
Operated by CDC Hunter Valley Coaches, students and parents can plan the new school journey on Trip Planner. View the news article for more information.
 
Changes by route:
  • New route 1337 - Maitland High School to Chisholm
    • New afternoon route
  • 2763 - St Aloysius PS to Maitland Grossman HS via Thornton
    • Morning service will extend to Maitland High School and Maitland Grossman School
  • 2522 - Mereweather HS to Bolwarra Heights
    • Afternoon service will now service Sophia Waters and Chisholm
  • 2611 - Chisholm to Mereweather High School
    • Morning service will now start in Sophia Waters
  • 1304 - San Clemente High School to Lakeside
    • To be withdrawn and alternative via route 1323.

infoLinks.urlText: Eastern Suburbs bus diversions for City2Surf
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 9 August
  • From 5.55am until 4pm, route 333 services will start and end trips on Sandridge Street due to the high volume of event shuttle buses running from Campbell Parade for the annual City2Surf fun run.  
  • Buses travelling towards Bondi Beach will run as normal to Bondi Road and then divert into Sandridge Street to end trips at a temporary bus stop at Sandridge St before Wilga St (2026123).  
  • Buses leaving Bondi and travelling to the city will start trips at Sandridge St at Fletcher St (2026109) and divert via Fletcher Street and Denham Street to return to route on Bondi Road. From 9am, buses will also stop at Bondi Junction Station to set down at Stand P (202266) and pick-up from Stand M (202279).  
  • All stops on Campbell Parade will be missed in both directions.  
  • Plan ahead, allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the City2Surf event page for more transport details.  
Missed stops:
  • Campbell Pde opp South Bondi Beach (202620) 
  • Bondi Beach, Campbell Pde, Stand C (202622)

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus improvements in Kiama and Jamberoo from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, we’re making changes to route S482 morning bus services in Kiama and Jamberoo to improve connectivity and travel times. 
  • Route S482 AM will now service only Jamberoo Public School.
  • Route S482 AM no longer operates to Kiama High School or Minnamurra Public School.
  • Kiama High School students from Jamberoo will instead use Route 125.
  • Students travelling to Minnamurra Public School from Curramore, Jamberoo or Jerrara who currently use the S482 morning service will need to change buses under the new arrangements. They will transfer from Route 125 to S493 at Ss Peter and Paul Catholic Parish Primary School at 8.37am. The bus schedules have been coordinated so students can move directly between services, with no waiting time required.
Plan your trip and read the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 603:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week.
  • All services extended between Tweed City Shopping Centre and Tweed Mall.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see the route 603 service Moss Street and Marine Parade.
  • Tweed City Shopping Centre will be serviced on Minjungbal Drive. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.content:
Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields

Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.

For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Watsons Bay service changes for City2Surf
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 9 August, route 324 services will start and end trips early, or not run at all, while roads are closed for the annual City2Surf fun run.  
 
Changes for buses leaving Watsons Bay and travelling towards the city:  
  • From 3.30am to 7am, buses will end trips at Edgecliff Station, Stand E (202716). An extra trip will also run at 6.36am. 
  • From 6.45am to 12pm, buses will not run. 
  • From 12pm, buses will start trips from Edgecliff Station, New South Head Rd, Stand N (202726). 
  • From 1.20pm, buses will start trips from New South Head Rd at Newcastle St (202955). 
  • At 2.14pm, the bus will start its trip from New South Head Rd at Old South Head Rd (2030136). 
  • At 2.44pm, the first complete trip from Watsons Bay will run to Walsh Bay. 
Changes for buses leaving Walsh Bay and travelling towards Watsons Bay:
  • From 3.30am to 12.15pm, buses will not run. 
  • At 12.16pm, a bus will run from Walsh Bay and end its trip at Edgecliff Station, Stand E (202716). 
  • From 12.46pm, buses will end trips at New South Head Rd at Caledonian Rd (202949). 
  • At 1.46pm, the first complete trip from Walsh Bay will run to Watsons Bay. 
  • At 2.10pm, the first complete trip from Edgecliff will run to Watsons Bay. 
Plan ahead, allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the City2Surf event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.
